lead_independence.headline: Martin County community rallies to restore mangrove island on St. Lucie River
lead_independence.lead: Lisa Standing, a resident at Piper's Landing Yacht and Country Club, rallied her neighbors to take action after watching the mangroves deteriorate. The community built 10 planter pools to grow red and white mangroves. Standing said the mangroves were so thick and lush and they have watched them deteriorate, and in some areas the island is dead now. The effort required extensive research and permitting before a single plant could go into the water.

lead_independence.headline: Tradition Lakes K-8 opening pushed back one week, leaving 1,100 Port St. Lucie families scrambling for child care
lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie Public Schools announced Thursday that the first day of classes at Tradition Lakes K-8 school will be pushed from August 10 to August 17, affecting approximately 1,100 students enrolled at the new school. Parents received notification of the delay just four days before the originally scheduled opening, sparking frustration among families who had already arranged work schedules and child care around the initial start date. Asia Shouford, a working mother of four children, said she was honestly annoyed because school starts on Monday and the notification came on Thursday. Shouford said the delay completely disrupted her carefully planned arrangements as a working mom with two little ones at home.
